## Fase I: Entendimiento del negocio

**Objetivo**: Estimar precios de viviendas en Sacramento con un pipeline reproducible de ciencia de datos.

![](../figures/vivienda.jpeg){fig-align='center' width='300'}

## Fase II: Entendimiento de los datos

```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy import sparse
import sklearn

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer, make_column_selector, make_column_transformer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler, FunctionTransformer
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
```

```{python}
# Discretización de precio para split estratificado

price_cuts = np.quantile(data["price"], [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8])
price_cuts
```

```{python}
data["price_cat"] = pd.cut(
    data["price"],
    bins=[-np.inf, price_cuts[0], price_cuts[1], price_cuts[2], price_cuts[3], np.inf],
    labels=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
)

data["price_cat"].value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index()
```

```{python}
# Split estratificado

strat_train, strat_test = train_test_split(
    data,
    test_size=0.30,
    stratify=data["price_cat"],
    random_state=1234
)

strat_test["price_cat"].value_counts(normalize=True).sort_values()
```

```{python}
# Comparación visual de distribuciones de price

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))

sns.histplot(strat_train, x="price", bins=20, stat="density", color="dodgerblue", ax=ax1)
sns.kdeplot(strat_train["price"], color="black", linewidth=2, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title("Training")

sns.histplot(strat_test, x="price", bins=20, stat="density", color="dodgerblue", ax=ax2)
sns.kdeplot(strat_test["price"], color="black", linewidth=2, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_title("Test")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# Quitamos variable auxiliar

for set_ in (strat_train, strat_test):
    set_.drop(columns=["price_cat"], inplace=True)
```

## Fase V: Preparación de datos

```{python}
# Definimos X/y de entrenamiento

X_train = strat_train.drop(columns=["price"]).copy()
y_train = strat_train["price"].copy()

X_test = strat_test.drop(columns=["price"]).copy()
y_test = strat_test["price"].copy()
```

```{python}
# Separación numérico/categórico

X_train_num = X_train.select_dtypes(include=np.number)
X_train_cat = X_train.select_dtypes(exclude=np.number)

X_train_num.head()
```

```{python}
# Imputación numérica

imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")
X_train_num_imp = pd.DataFrame(
    imputer.fit_transform(X_train_num),
    columns=X_train_num.columns,
    index=X_train_num.index,
)

X_train_num_imp.head()
```

```{python}
# One-hot para categóricas

encoder = OneHotEncoder(drop="first", handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False)
X_train_cat_1hot = encoder.fit_transform(X_train_cat)

categories = encoder.categories_
categories
```

```{python}
# Escalamiento estándar

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_num_std = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_num_imp)
X_train_num_std[:5]
```

```{python}
# Shortcut equivalente

X_train_num_std2 = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X_train_num_imp)
np.allclose(X_train_num_std, X_train_num_std2)
```

```{python}
# Transformación logarítmica de sqft

log_transformer = FunctionTransformer(func=np.log, inverse_func=np.exp)
log_sqft = np.asarray(log_transformer.fit_transform(X_train_num_imp[["sqft"]])).ravel()
log_sqft[:5]
```

```{python}
# Función auxiliar para cocientes

def column_ratio(X):
    return X[:, [0]] / X[:, [1]]


def ratio_name(function_transformer, feature_names_in):
    return ["ratio"]
```

```{python}
# Transformer de razón

ratio_transf = FunctionTransformer(column_ratio, feature_names_out=ratio_name)

baths_per_sqft = ratio_transf.transform(X_train_num_imp[["baths", "sqft"]].to_numpy())
beds_per_sqft = ratio_transf.transform(X_train_num_imp[["beds", "sqft"]].to_numpy())

baths_per_sqft[:5], beds_per_sqft[:5]
```

```{python}
# Pipeline numérico base

num_pipeline = make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy="median"), StandardScaler())
X_train_num_prepared = num_pipeline.fit_transform(X_train_num)
X_train_num_prepared[:5]
```

```{python}
# Pipeline categórico

cat_pipeline = make_pipeline(
    SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent"),
    OneHotEncoder(drop="first", handle_unknown="ignore")
)

X_train_cat_prepared = cat_pipeline.fit_transform(X_train_cat)
X_train_cat_prepared.shape
```

```{python}
# Column transformer simple

preprocessing_simple = make_column_transformer(
    (num_pipeline, make_column_selector(dtype_include=np.number)),
    (cat_pipeline, make_column_selector(dtype_include=object)),
)

X_train_prepared_simple = preprocessing_simple.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_prepared_simple.shape
```

```{python}
# Pipelines especializadas

def ratio_pipeline():
    return make_pipeline(
        SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
        FunctionTransformer(column_ratio, feature_names_out=ratio_name),
        StandardScaler(),
    )


log_pipeline = make_pipeline(
    SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
    FunctionTransformer(np.log, np.exp, feature_names_out="one-to-one"),
    StandardScaler(),
)


default_num_pipeline = make_pipeline(
    SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
    StandardScaler(),
)
```

```{python}
# Preprocesamiento completo

preprocessing = ColumnTransformer(
    [
        ("default", default_num_pipeline, ["baths", "beds"]),
        ("baths", ratio_pipeline(), ["baths", "sqft"]),
        ("beds", ratio_pipeline(), ["beds", "sqft"]),
        ("log", log_pipeline, ["sqft"]),
        ("cat", cat_pipeline, make_column_selector(dtype_exclude=np.number)),
    ],
    remainder=default_num_pipeline,
)

X_train_prepared = preprocessing.fit_transform(X_train)
if sparse.issparse(X_train_prepared):
    X_train_prepared = X_train_prepared.toarray()
X_train_prepared = pd.DataFrame(
    X_train_prepared,
    columns=preprocessing.get_feature_names_out(),
    index=X_train.index,
)

X_train_prepared.head()
```

```{python}
# Transformamos también el conjunto de prueba con el mismo preprocesamiento

X_test_prepared = preprocessing.transform(X_test)
if sparse.issparse(X_test_prepared):
    X_test_prepared = X_test_prepared.toarray()
X_test_prepared = pd.DataFrame(
    X_test_prepared,
    columns=preprocessing.get_feature_names_out(),
    index=X_test.index,
)

X_test_prepared.head()
```

## Fase VI: Feature selection con BorutaShap

```{python}
# Selección de variables con BorutaShap usando un modelo de árboles

try:
    from BorutaShap import BorutaShap
except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
    raise ModuleNotFoundError(
        "BorutaShap no está instalado. Instálalo con: pip install BorutaShap shap"
    ) from exc

feature_selector = BorutaShap(
    model=RandomForestRegressor(
        n_estimators=300,
        random_state=42,
        n_jobs=-1,
        min_samples_leaf=2,
    ),
    importance_measure="shap",
    classification=False,
)

feature_selector.fit(
    X=X_train_prepared,
    y=y_train,
    n_trials=30,
    sample=False,
    train_or_test="test",
    normalize=True,
    verbose=True,
    random_state=42,
)
```

```{python}
# Gráfica del peso/importancia de variables según BorutaShap

plotted = False
try:
    feature_selector.plot(which_features="all")
    plt.title("Peso de variables - BorutaShap")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
    plotted = True
except TypeError:
    try:
        feature_selector.plot()
        plt.title("Peso de variables - BorutaShap")
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
        plotted = True
    except Exception:
        plotted = False
except Exception:
    plotted = False

if not plotted:
    # Fallback: construimos pesos con el historial de importancias disponible
    importance_source = None
    for attr in [
        "history_x",
        "importance_history_",
        "importance_values_",
        "feature_importances_",
    ]:
        if hasattr(feature_selector, attr):
            importance_source = getattr(feature_selector, attr)
            break

    if importance_source is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "No se encontró historial de importancias en feature_selector para graficar."
        )

    if isinstance(importance_source, pd.DataFrame):
        if {"Feature", "Importance"}.issubset(importance_source.columns):
            weights = (
                importance_source.groupby("Feature")["Importance"]
                .mean()
                .sort_values(ascending=False)
            )
        else:
            weights = importance_source.mean(axis=0).sort_values(ascending=False)
    else:
        arr = np.asarray(importance_source)
        if arr.ndim == 1:
            if arr.shape[0] != X_train_prepared.shape[1]:
                raise RuntimeError("No se pudo alinear importancias con las variables.")
            weights = pd.Series(arr, index=X_train_prepared.columns).sort_values(ascending=False)
        elif arr.ndim == 2:
            if arr.shape[1] == X_train_prepared.shape[1]:
                weights = pd.Series(np.nanmean(arr, axis=0), index=X_train_prepared.columns).sort_values(ascending=False)
            elif arr.shape[0] == X_train_prepared.shape[1]:
                weights = pd.Series(np.nanmean(arr, axis=1), index=X_train_prepared.columns).sort_values(ascending=False)
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("No se pudo alinear historial de importancias con las variables.")
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Formato no soportado para historial de importancias.")

    top_n = min(20, len(weights))
    plt.figure(figsize=(9, 6))
    sns.barplot(x=weights.head(top_n).values, y=weights.head(top_n).index, orient="h")
    plt.title(f"Top {top_n} pesos de variables (BorutaShap)")
    plt.xlabel("Peso promedio")
    plt.ylabel("Variable")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
# Variables aceptadas por BorutaShap

selected_features = feature_selector.accepted
selected_features
```

```{python}
# Subconjuntos finales para modelado

if len(selected_features) == 0:
    selected_features = X_train_prepared.columns.tolist()

X_train_selected = X_train_prepared[selected_features].copy()
X_test_selected = X_test_prepared[selected_features].copy()

X_train_selected.shape, X_test_selected.shape
```

## Fase VII: Modelado y evaluación

```{python}
# Modelo lineal sobre variables seleccionadas

lin_model = LinearRegression()
lin_model.fit(X_train_selected, y_train)
```

```{python}
# Validación cruzada RMSE (lineal)

lin_rmse_cv = -cross_val_score(
    lin_model,
    X_train_selected,
    y_train,
    scoring="neg_root_mean_squared_error",
    cv=5,
)

pd.Series(lin_rmse_cv).describe()
```

```{python}
# Modelo de árboles

rf_model = RandomForestRegressor(
    n_estimators=300,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
)

rf_rmse_cv = -cross_val_score(
    rf_model,
    X_train_selected,
    y_train,
    scoring="neg_root_mean_squared_error",
    cv=5,
)

pd.Series(rf_rmse_cv).describe()
```

```{python}
# Entrenamos el mejor modelo y evaluamos en test

rf_model.fit(X_train_selected, y_train)
pred_test = rf_model.predict(X_test_selected)

mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, pred_test)
rmse = mean_squared_error(y_test, pred_test) ** 0.5
r2 = r2_score(y_test, pred_test)

{"MAE": mae, "RMSE": rmse, "R2": r2}
```

```{python}
# Ejemplo de predicciones

pred_sample = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "real": y_test.head(10),
        "prediccion": pred_test[:10],
    }
)
pred_sample
```
